questions.question: Discuss the negative impact of AI.
questions.solution_html:
• Artificial Intelligence (AI) has many advantages, but it also creates several negative impacts
  • on society.
  • Job Displacement – Automation may replace human workers in industries, leading to
  • unemployment.
  • Privacy Concerns – AI systems collect large amounts of personal data, increasing the risk of
  • surveillance and misuse.
  • Bias and Discrimination – AI algorithms may reflect social biases and produce unfair
  • decisions.
  • Cybercrime and Misuse – AI can be used for hacking, deepfakes, and spreading
  • misinformation.
  • Dependence on Technology – Excessive reliance on AI may reduce human creativity and
  • decision-making abilities.
  • Ethical Issues – Lack of accountability in AI decisions raises moral and legal concerns.
  • Therefore, responsible use and regulation of AI are essential for protecting society.
questions.final_answer: Therefore, responsible use and regulation of AI are essential for protecting society

questions.question: List and explain some examples of respectful and positive behaviour online.
questions.solution_html:
• List and Explain Some Examples of Respectful and Positive Behaviour Online
  • Positive online behaviour promotes healthy digital interaction and cyber ethics.
  • Examples
  • Using Polite Language
  • Communicating respectfully without abusive or offensive words.
  • Respecting Privacy
  • Not sharing others’ personal information or images without permission.
  • Avoiding Cyberbullying
  • Treating others kindly and not harassing or humiliating people online.
  • Sharing Accurate Information
  • Verifying facts before forwarding messages or news.
  • Acknowledging Others’ Opinions
  • Respecting different viewpoints and engaging in constructive discussions.
  • Practicing Digital Responsibility
  • Following ethical rules and reporting harmful online activities.
  • Such behaviours help create safe and inclusive online communities.
questions.final_answer: Such behaviours help create safe and inclusive online communities

questions.question: What is the concept of a network society, and what are its defining characteristics?
questions.solution_html:
• The concept of a network society was developed by Manuel Castells. A network society is a
  • society where social, economic, and cultural activities are organized through digital
  • communication networks.
  • Characteristics
  • Global Connectivity – People are connected across the world through the internet.
  • Information-Based Economy – Knowledge and information become key economic resources.
  • Digital Communication – Online interaction replaces many traditional forms of
  • communication.
  • Flexibility and Decentralization – Networks allow flexible and rapid exchange of information.
  • Virtual Communities – Social relationships increasingly occur in digital spaces.
  • The network society has transformed work, education, politics, and social relationships.
questions.final_answer: The network society has transformed work, education, politics, and social relationships

questions.question: How does identity theft occur in the digital world, and what can individuals do to safeguard their personal information?
questions.solution_html:
• Safeguard their Personal Information?
  • Identity theft occurs when criminals steal personal information such as passwords, bank
  • details, Aadhaar numbers, or social media credentials for fraudulent purposes.
  • Common Methods
  • Phishing emails and fake websites
  • Hacking and malware attacks
  • Data breaches
  • Social engineering techniques
  • Safeguarding Measures
  • Use strong and unique passwords.
  • Enable two-factor authentication.
  • Avoid sharing sensitive information online.
  • Update software and antivirus systems regularly.
  • Be cautious while opening suspicious emails or links.
  • Use secure websites for online transactions.
  • Digital awareness and cyber security practices help protect individuals from identity theft.
questions.final_answer: Digital awareness and cyber security practices help protect individuals from identity theft
